answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The falcon cap is policed at intake and sparrow shows the per-origin counts. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a ocean tag. That is 9 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
